Bases: BackEulerImplicitIntegration

Backward Euler variant with MTI inequality/mode checks.

This solver keeps the same Newton/Jacobian structure as BackEulerImplicitIntegration and adds a post-Newton MTI feasibility gate based on inequality residuals G <= tol.

Bases: OptionsTemplate

Options for pseudo-transient initialization.

Parameters:

  • use_weighted_residual – Whether to weight the convergence residual.

  • weight_algebraic – Algebraic residual weight.

  • use_weighted_linear_solve – Whether to weight the linear solve system.

  • linear_solve_state_weight – State row weight for weighted linear solves.

  • linear_solve_algebraic_weight – Algebraic row weight for weighted linear solves.

  • use_state_tau_scaling – Whether to adapt state pseudo-time constants.

  • use_state_tau_dtau_scale – Whether state tau scaling depends on pseudo-time step.

  • state_tau_min – Minimum state pseudo-time constant.

  • state_tau_max – Maximum state pseudo-time constant.

  • state_tau_eps – Numerical floor for state tau scaling.

  • allow_lsqr_fallback – Whether singular/rectangular solves may use LSQR.

  • use_svd_diagnostics – Whether to print SVD diagnostics.

  • svd_diagnostics_limit – Maximum automatic SVD diagnostic reports.

  • linear_solve_damp – LSQR damping value. Positive values force regularized LSQR.

  • artificial_algebraic_mass – Optional algebraic diagonal mass value.

  • artificial_algebraic_mass_names – Algebraic variable names receiving artificial mass.

  • positive_clamp_names – Variable names receiving hard positive clamp.

  • positive_clamp_min – Hard positive clamp floor.

  • soft_positive_names – Variable names receiving soft positive floor.

  • soft_positive_min – Soft positive floor.

  • soft_positive_eps – Soft positive smoothness parameter.

  • dtau_ser_min_factor – Minimum SER pseudo-time scaling factor.

  • dtau_ser_max_factor – Maximum SER pseudo-time scaling factor.

  • dtau_stall_ratio – Residual ratio considered stalled.

  • dtau_stall_steps – Number of stalled steps before pseudo-time boost.

  • dtau_stall_boost – Pseudo-time boost factor after a stall.

  • stop_on_residual_stall – Whether to end the current simulation when residuals stop improving.

  • residual_reset_steps – Number of accepted residuals in the reset window.

  • residual_reset_improvement_tol – Relative residual improvement required to avoid reset.
